public_claim_boundary: This runbook is not private holdout evidence. It defines the maintainer-only operation procedure, but rotating_private_holdouts_implemented remains incomplete until validated active and shadow or candidate packs exist with real rotation metadata.
operation_steps: stage active pack under ignored maintainer holdout root
stage shadow or candidate pack under ignored maintainer holdout root
run holdout-pack validation on each declared pack
write rotation metadata in ignored maintainer holdout root
compute active pack fingerprint from validated manifests
compute each pack fingerprint from validated manifests
record concrete version labels and matching SHA-256 fingerprints for every pack
tie source summaries and leaderboard rows to active fingerprint
rerun no-tools and tool-agent baselines after scoring or pack changes
mark old rows stale or legacy after rotation
run privacy scan before publishing redacted summaries
command_templates: git ls-files tasks_private/holdout results captures docs/reviews/panel-logs
acceptance_checks: at least one shadow or candidate pack
declared pack fingerprints match computed pack fingerprints
compatibility policy documented with concrete comparison and old-row rules
retirement triggers documented as concrete non-placeholder triggers
rerun policy requires no-tools and tool-agent baseline reruns before current comparison
old row stale policy documented as legacy_snapshot or deprecated
publication_rules: public output is count-level or redacted summary only
nonpublic protected evidence stays in protected storage
private task bodies are never published
nonpublic task identifiers are never published
local absolute paths are never published
release_notes: A passing runbook check only proves that the private holdout operation procedure is specified.
The rotation gate requires real maintainer-only rotation metadata with active and shadow or candidate packs.
The repeated private evidence gates require eligible private leaderboard rows tied to the active pack fingerprint.
